description:
FEMA flood zone at a US street address (any of the 50 states or DC), free. `address` = full street address
        with house number, city and state, e.g. "1600 Pennsylvania Ave NW, Washington, DC 20500".

        Returns the zone (A/AE/V/VE = Special Flood Hazard Area, shaded X = 0.2% annual chance, X, D), a plain-language
        label and explanation, whether federal rules require flood insurance for a federally backed mortgage, base flood
        elevation where FEMA publishes one, and a FEMA Flood Map Service Center link for the official map panel.

        status: 'ok'; 'invalid' (the address could not be matched: the message says why; ask the user to correct it);
        'unavailable' (FEMA or the Census geocoder did not answer: the zone was NOT determined, this is never a
        'no flood zone' answer; retry later); 'rate_limited'. Always tell the user this is a screening from FEMA's
        layer, not an official flood zone determination (lenders use FEMA's Standard Flood Hazard Determination Form).
name: flood_zone_lookup
